sentences.text:
Ranveer Singh Jadaun vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 12
December, 2024

Author: Gurpal Singh Ahluwalia
Bench: G. S. Ahluwalia
 Neutral Citation No. 2024:Mphc-Gwl:22118
 1 
 In The High Court Of Madhya Pradesh
 At Gwalior
 Before
 Hon'Ble Shri Justice G. S. Ahluwalia
 On The 12th Of December, 2024
 Misc. Criminal Case No. 10312 of 2020
 Ranveer Singh Jadaun
 Versus
 The State Of Madhya Pradesh And Others
 Appearance:
 Shri V.S.Chauhan- Advocate for the applicant.
 Shri N.K.Gupta- Public Prosecutor for the State.

entities.text:
High Court Of Madhya Pradesh
 At Gwalior
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Order 
This application under Section 482 of Cr.P.C. has been filed seeking the following relief:-
"It is, therefore, most respectfully prayed that the petition filed by the petitioner may kindly be allowed and the part of impugned order dated 20/12/2019 passed by Shweta Goyal Ji VIth ASJ Bhind passed in CRR 57/2019 by which the first information report (F.I.R.) at crime No.120/19 registered by P.S. Raun District Bhind for offence punishable under section 420, 467, 468, 471, 120B of IPC has been remained in existent, may kindly be set aside and may kindly be quashed the under challenge F.I.R. and all consequential proceeding thereon, in the interest of justice."
After arguing the matter at length, counsel for applicant seeks permission of this Court to withdraw this application.
It is, accordingly, dismissed as withdrawn.

(G. S. AHLUWALIA) JUDGE PjS/-
